title: Reject the inference from a long quiet mechanical record to permanent rigidity
statement: If a finite-time solidity declaration has false-solid probability<=alpha for every Maxwell rate lambda>0, then its finite-declaration probability under the permanent spring is also<=alpha, even with unbounded stopping and bounded causal controls.

requires: Initially equilibrated linear passive positive relaxation measure, g>=0, g+mass(mu)=A, calibrated common additive Gaussian noise sigma and bounded causal strain. Binary step dominance requires nonnegative contrast kernel; passivity alone is insufficient. Rate-floor minimax test requires an independently known positive lower relaxation rate.
provides: If a finite-time solidity declaration has false-solid probability<=alpha for every Maxwell rate lambda>0, then its finite-declaration probability under the permanent spring is also<=alpha, even with unbounded stopping and bounded causal controls.
assumptions: A finite fitted spectrum does not acquire a rate floor. Tolerance upper bound cannot certify exact g=0 or positive permanent rigidity. Pointwise convergence is consistent with uniform impossibility; the slow alternative in a lower-bound proof can depend on horizon. Half-normal mixture statistics are established Howard et al. machinery. All-window ordinary comparator won30/32 final comparisons, with two uninformative ties; empirical coverage fractions are not universal guarantees. No acquired measurement, fabricated device, historical priority, efficient algorithm or practical advantage is inferred from these mathematical/model results. Mission NOT_ACHIEVED.
costs: Pay horizon, peak strain, readout noise, preparation/reset and actual work. Strain-squared exposure is not mechanical work. Finite thermal acceleration preserves the missing rate floor. Continuous-time confidence and finite64-readout all-window correction have different interfaces.
contract.units: g,A moduli; lambda inverse time; strain U dimensionless; stress noise density sigma follows dY=stress*dt+sigma*dW. Counts and time budgets differ.
contract.obstruction: Independently exclude slower alternatives or acquire a supported additional observable for exact long-term claims. Use valid upper tolerance certificates where that weaker task is sufficient.

body: For each fixed T, finite-history total variation tends to zero as lambda tends to zero, using the known-pair positive-kernel step comparator. Thus the event declare-by-T has spring probability<=alpha. Increase T and apply continuity from below. No one positive lambda is claimed indistinguishable forever. At a fixed finite horizon the modulus minimax MSE is A²/4; an independently acquired rate floor permits the different sharp matched-filter test. Passive RC filters with sign-changing contrast show why passivity alone cannot justify step optimality.
